justification: Inspected `src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/text/StrBuilder.java` (lines 177-205 and 1534-1535). `StrBuilderTokenizer` is a tiny nested adapter with no fields, one empty constructor, and only two overridden methods: `getContent()` and `tokenize(...)`. Its behavior is narrowly scoped to delegating to `StrTokenizer` while binding to the enclosing `StrBuilder`, so there is no evidence of excessive size, multiple responsibilities, or a need to split it into smaller abstractions.
